about: A great leathery-winged flying reptile that soars over the sea and screeches as it dives.
notes: v1 brief for the torch backend (MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 on CUDA). Each prompt asks for several events with pauses in one 8 s file, and the picker cuts the best of them. Slots with loop: true are beds: the picker cuts a seamless stretch.

prompts.text: A large flying reptile gives raspy screeching cries like a giant seabird, three separate calls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large flying reptile shrieks a loud alarmed squawk, three separate shrieks with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large flying reptile squawks in pain, four separate cries with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large flying reptile gives a weak fading dying squawk, two separate times with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large flying reptile snaps its long beak shut with a hiss, five separate snaps with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Huge leathery wings flapping: deep slow whooshing wingbeats, several separate takeoffs. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Huge leathery wings beat slowly in flight: deep rhythmic whooshing flaps. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
